column3: but found nothing.\nJust broken glass and\nash.{end_wait}
Hey...{pause_20_skippable} Boy...\nCome closer.{end_wait}
You have business with\nme, or are you lost?{end_now}
Vale has been so quiet\nsince you two left. Even\nthe sky looks gray.{end_wait}
Sniff... I...{pause_20_skippable} I'm not\nafraid at all... Go.\n{pause_20_skippable}Just go!{end_wait}
Take this. It may be the\nlast thing I give you.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} took\nthe Herb.{end_wait}
You must save {actor_name:6}!{pause_20_skippable}\nBring her home, {actor_name:1}!{end_wait}
Come back a warrior,\n{actor_name:1}. A living one.{page_break}By then I'll be a\nsmith worth the name.{end_wait}
I wanted {actor_name:6} for my\ndaughter-in-law...{pause_20_skippable}{page_break}Now she's gone. And I\ncan't even grieve right.{end_wait}

Those visitors brought
the fire down on us and
took {actor_name:6}.{page_break}I knew something was
wrong with them from
the start.{end_wait}
That masked man...\nHe was {actor_name:5}, right?{end_now}
I hate to say it, but...\nwhat if {actor_name:6} was in\non it from the start?{end_wait}
What?{pause_20_skippable} But didn't {actor_name:6}\nsee his face?{end_now}
If he's her brother, we\nshouldn't trust\n{actor_name:6} too much.{end_wait}
What? That's not what you\ntold the elders.{end_wait}

We're a small hotel, and
we get few guests...{page_break}We sweep out the ash
every morning. Someone
might still come.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, please bring my\ngrandson {actor_name:2} home\nalive.{end_wait}
A quest from the Wise One.\nHonor... or a sentence.\nI can't tell.{end_wait}

As mothers{pause_20_skippable}, Dora and I
will never stop worrying
about you.{page_break}No matter how old you
get, you'll be our
babies. Come back.{end_wait}
Please bring back my\ngranddaughter, {actor_name:6}.\n{pause_20_skippable}I will be waiting.{end_wait}
After {actor_name:6} was taken,\nGrandmother grew sick\nwith grief...{end_wait}
It's because Kraden was\nplaying with Alchemy...{page_break}That's why the mountain\nburned, isn't it?{end_wait}
They say whoever caused\nthis had strange powers.{page_break}...{pause_20_skippable}Is that true?{end_now}
If they used Psynergy...{page_break}Then Vale isn't the only\nplace that has it. That\nfrightens me.{end_wait}
Then it's just a rumor.\nI don't need to worry.{page_break}Psynergy belongs to\nVale alone. It has to.{end_wait}
I envy you, being able to\nleave this town... Tch!\nDon't make me say it.{end_wait}
Once you leave town, don't\nuse Psynergy in front of\nstrangers. They'll fear it.{end_wait}

I never knew such a
secret lay in Sol Sanctum.{page_break}If we had, we could
have stopped this before
it began.{end_wait}
{protagonist_name}, it will be a\nhard road. Don't let it\nbreak you.{end_wait}
If the road is too hard,\nyou may come home. We\nwon't think less of you.{end_wait}

So if {actor_name:5} was the one
who took {actor_name:6}...{page_break}Then why must you be
the one to bring her
back?{end_wait}
I will think of {actor_name:6}\nas I work...{page_break}We're all counting on\nyou, {protagonist_name}.{end_wait}
Now that {actor_name:6} is gone,\nwe need someone to fill\nher place. As if we could.{end_wait}

Who could have known that
masked man was
{actor_name:5}!?{page_break}He hid his face from us.
He must have been
ashamed.{end_wait}

I wonder how much
{actor_name:5} changed. He was
such a good boy...{page_break}Could {actor_name:6} change like
that, too?{end_wait}

{actor_name:5} and his gang left
in a hurry.{page_break}I found his coin purse
while cleaning. There was
blood on it.{end_wait}

It's hard letting my
precious {actor_name:2} go...{page_break}But I have to be strong
for everyone. I have
to.{end_wait}
The Wise One chose {actor_name:2}\nhimself. I'm proud of my\nboy. And terrified.{end_wait}

Once {actor_name:2} leaves, I
won't rest until he's
home.{page_break}At least I have another
child to hold. That
helps. A little.{end_wait}

I worry for {actor_name:2}, but
he is my son. I am sure he
will{page_break}be all right. I can't
wait until he returns to
Vale a strong man.{end_wait}

{actor_name:5} inherited his
father's gift with
Psynergy.{page_break}Open your eyes, {actor_name:5}.
Use that gift for good,
not for this.{end_wait}

{actor_name:6}, if danger comes,
use your Psynergy and
fight it.{page_break}The fire you inherited
from your mother will
burn for you. Hold on.{end_wait}
Why would {actor_name:5} take his\nown sister, {actor_name:6}, away?{end_wait}
We nearly lost the town\nover something as foolish\nas the study of Alchemy.{end_wait}
I'd like to believe only\nValeans can use Psynergy.\nI'd like to believe a lot.{end_wait}
Vale's laws forbid Psynergy\nin front of outsiders.{page_break}You know that,\ndon't you, {protagonist_name}?{end_wait}
I wish I'd solved the\nmystery of Sol Sanctum\nbefore the sky went gray.{end_wait}

There are books entitled
"Journey to the Northern
Continent of Angara"{page_break}and "All About the
Southern Continent of
Gondowan."{page_break}{actor_name:1} learned that Mt.
Aleph sits at Angara's
western edge. It burned.{end_wait}

There is a book entitled
"The Laws of Vale," which
describes Vale's customs.{page_break}"Never leave the village
without permission.{page_break}Never show Psynergy to
outsiders. Never speak of
the Sanctum..."{end_wait}

There is a book entitled
"The Mighty Power of
Nature."{page_break}"Beyond human reason,
nature shows its power in
eruptions{page_break}and floods. It does not
spare the innocent..."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"The Psynergy Stone."{page_break}"Psynergy is restored by
touching a Psynergy Stone.
Some say it feeds on us."{end_wait}

There's a notebook
belonging to {actor_name:6}'s
aunt...{page_break}Sketches by {actor_name:6}'s
aunt and mother as girls.
Happier days.{end_wait}
There's a book entitled\n\"Making a Great Village.\"{page_break}Its margins are filled\nwith names crossed out.{end_wait}

There's a notebook called
"Study of Alchemy."{page_break}"To understand Alchemy,
one must understand the
Elemental Powers..."{page_break}That's where the writing
ends. The rest of the page
is scorched.{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"In Search of the Ancient
Lemurians."{page_break}Someone has underlined:
"They did not vanish.
They were taken."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"The Fountain
of Tolbi."{page_break}"The fountain of Tolbi
will test your luck...
Or take it."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"Encyclopedia of Alchemy"{page_break}"All things are made of
four elements. Even we
return to them..."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"Legend of Mt. Aleph."{page_break}It says the mountain's
name means the origin of
all things. And its end...{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"Being an Adept."{page_break}"Hone your Psynergy. Do
not use it for evil. It
remembers..."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"Etiquette for
Travelers."{page_break}"It is rude not to
introduce yourself to
the town's mayor."{page_break}Beneath it, in pencil:
"Also, check the exits."{end_wait}
